notes.title: (0.1.1.2) Staff Improvement & Save Backups
notes.content:
[h2]Thanks everyone for reporting these issues[/h2] 
Any reported bugs will be addressed in a timely manner, please do report bugs.

[b][IMPROVED] [/b] Restockers will prioritize getting the already open or half full boxes instead of opening new full boxes.

[b][IMPROVED] [/b] Restockers should no longer slack off.

[b][NEW] [/b] An auto save backup system is in place.


[b][FIXED] [/b] Boxes left by restockers just near a shelf makes a constant "glitchy" sound.
[b][FIXED] [/b]In multiplayer, when you join someone's game, and your a cashier, holding down the scan key to auto scan products causes the products not be scanned for other people in the lobby.

notes.title: BEST TIME TO SELL EASTER EGGS! (TIMED EVENT)
notes.content:
It's Easter times! 
And every shopman and shopwoman know what this means!

[b]Customers will be looking for Easter Eggs to buy, and this is the perfect time to sell Easter Egg in your shop.[/b]
Every year all shops can order Easter Baskets to sell in their shop, without paying for a license.

That is if you want to of course.

[h2]How do I sell Easter Eggs?[/h2]
Just order them the regular way, open the product market app, add "Easter Basket" to the shopping cart and place order.

[b]Customers won't complain about having no Easter eggs,[/b]
but they will be on the lookout for Easter eggs during the event, maybe only a few customers complain just after you sold-out all of the Easter Baskets, but you will restock again no worries....right?.....right?

[h1]From now thru April 24th.[/h1]

🥚Happy Easter!

notes.title: (0.1.1.1) Easter Event - Patch Note
notes.content:
[h2]Thanks everyone for reporting these issues[/h2] 
Any reported bugs will be addressed in a timely manner, please do report bugs.

[b][NEW] [/b] Customer will be on a lookout for Easter eggs to buy, for duration of the event.

[h3]Notable Fixes:[/h3]

[b][FIXED] [/b] After loading a save, rejecting or accepting offers/contracts
[b][FIXED] [/b] sometimes Customer getting stuck by Fridge or Freezer.
[b][FIXED] [/b] Restockers standing still after sometimes and not doing their jobs.
[b][FIXED] [/b] Restockers only put 3 cereals on the shelves and dispose the reset, [i]secretly[/i].
[b][FIXED] [/b] Number of products in the box shown incorrectly for some items in the Product Market app.

[b][CHANGE] [/b]In multiplayer, anyone should be able to buy Wall Expansions.

notes.title: (0.1.1.0) First Content Update - Patch Note
notes.content:
Big Content update, these content was suggested by the community.
[h3]There will be a Post containing more info about this update soo,[/h3]

[b][NEW] [MAJOR] [/b]A large variety of products has been added, with more license for every level and more

[h1]Thanks everyone for reporting these issues[/h1] 
They all will be addressed in a timely manner.

[b][CHANGE] [/b]Fruit should now be stocked on a Vegetable shelf, instead of fridge shelf. if you already have fruits from previously, then you should stock them in the fridge.


[b][FIXED] [/b]Lottery Ticket Winnings isn't shown correctly at the end of the day report.
[b][FIXED] [/b]Fired staff can't be recruited again from the recruit app.

[b][FIXED] [/b]After loading a save, shelves incorrectly shown 2 as the total number of products in it

notes.title: (0.1.0.3) Expansion Cost & Fixes
notes.content:
Hot fix, reported by the community.
[h1]Thanks everyone for reporting these issues[/h1] 
They all will be addressed in a timely manner.

[b][CHANGE] [/b]Expansion cost is now lower, by popular demand.
[b][CHANGE] [/b]Customers are more careful with their budget


[b][FIXED] [/b]In multiplayer, sometimes the changes and the total for the cash register isn't correctly shown.
[b][FIXED] [/b]In multiplayer, the end day prompt is visible throughout the day.
[b][FIXED] [/b]After loading a save, the staff isn't present anymore. This fix should prevent this from happening. (If you loaded a save and the staff wasn't there anymore, I'm afraid they grab your money and ran away)
[b][FIXED] [/b]The "inventory" key tab is now working, and selecting "Nothing" will un-equip your hand-held items.
[b][FIXED] [/b]Staff salaries aren't being deducted.

notes.title: DEMO IS AVAILABLE, Manage your shop in a relaxing Sim
notes.content:
Exciting news!
Set up shop in a relaxing city and keep open through the [i]vibey[/i] nights (if you want).


[h3]Aside from the complete shop managing experience...[/h3]

Try you chance at Scratch Tickets! both sell them or scratch them your self.
Who knows maybe you won that $1,000,000,000 prize, and putting that money to the benefit of a certain apartment you can buy, in the game.

[b]Decisions Matters[/b]
Man in the suit from the corporate world will come to your successful shop! they may offer you a deal or a contract, review and decide.


Tip: Don't try to play your imported music in your shop, full of customers, you know, from the Music Station App in the shop computer, after you've bought an speaker, yep don't do that.


[h2]Try the Demo and share your thoughts[/h2]
